title: Expensive, Misleading, and Poorly Edited
body: I gave this app a fair chance because I enjoy reading, but it quickly became one of the most expensive and frustrating reading experiences I’ve had. The business model encourages stories to be stretched far beyond what they need to be. Instead of paying a reasonable price for a novel, you’re either locked into a subscription that’s difficult to cancel or forced to unlock chapters individually. By the time you finish a single story, you’ve often spent many times what you would have paid for a professionally published ebook. What finally pushed me to leave this review is that the app doesn’t accurately represent how much of a story is left. More than once, I thought I was approaching the end, only to discover I wasn’t even halfway through. That creates pressure to keep spending because you’ve already invested so much time and money. It feels misleading. The quality of the writing is another major issue. Many stories read as though they were never properly edited. Characters contradict themselves, major conversations seem to be forgotten a chapter later, living situations and important details suddenly change without explanation, and dramatic events are reversed almost immediately. Whether that’s because the stories are AI-generated, AI-assisted, or simply poorly edited, I can’t say—but the end result is the same: inconsistent storytelling that often feels artificially prolonged to maximize revenue rather than tell a good story. If you enjoy reading novels, you’ll get far better value buying ebooks from Amazon, Kobo, or your local library’s digital collection. You’ll spend less, get a complete, professionally edited story, and avoid feeling nickel-and-dimed every few pages. I won’t be using this app again.

However, in the first 4 days, I realized that the ad was far from the truth which makes purchasing a subscription a waste of money. The site doesn’t give you the completed books; you must either wait while the site gives you a few chapters at a time, or purchase coins to continue reading. It makes it difficult to complete the stories, especially when they drag on and on with some books having over 1200 chapters and some with as few as 500. As a college English professor/teacher for 30 years, it became quite clear in every one of the 7 books I started reading that they all contained continuity errors, forgotten subplots, and contradictory plotlines. I requested a refund, but have yet to receive one. If you’re searching for a site with quality stories, this site is NOT it!

body: The storyline is interesting & easily holds my attention. Characters are well defined. (I am currently at Chapter460). The problem is the inconsistencies. Audriana lives in an apartment then suddenly in a small house that explodes. Desmond Sullivan is Audriana’s father & Hailee’s father, married to Dagny, Hailee’s mother; then a few chapters later he’s listed as their uncle. The first half of the book has Audriana’s Grandfather as demeaning, threatening her, hating her, & in a wheelchair, then somewhere around chapter 200-250 he’s her loving grandfather in a home & the family members are systematically poisoning him & using his health as a threat. At that point, Meredith Sullivan, his wife becomes the aggressor. One chapter has grandfather moved sway from Sullivans into the Sinclair’s clinic , then a couple of chapters later he’s listed is in the ‘medical wing’ of the Sullivan mansion. Etc & etc.; very confusing!! Another issue is in the often something occurs in one chapter, then in the next chapter the same scenario is presented in a different way or with a different outcome. I’ve never been able to watch multiple ads like this in such little time and get to still read so many chapters in one day. Their ads are not tiring ads either, they’re quick and painless. I’m real and I’m not a robot, yep that’s what they all say. BUT I’m just a girl that loves her romance novels and can’t afford to pay for them right now, so this is so helpful. GIRLIES this is your app if you have the patience to wait for free chapters👍🏻
